targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') AS metric, CASE WHEN value_boolean THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'functional.response_produced_without_error' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%' AND ('$scenario' = 'all' OR replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') = '$scenario') ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time, replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') AS metric, value_numeric / 100.0 AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'cost.cost_cents' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%' AND ('$scenario' = 'all' OR replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') = '$scenario') ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time, replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') AS metric, value_numeric AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'cache.input_cached_ratio' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%' AND ('$scenario' = 'all' OR replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') = '$scenario') ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time, replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') AS metric, value_numeric AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'latency_ms.completion_p95_ms' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%' AND ('$scenario' = 'all' OR replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') = '$scenario') ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') AS metric, SUM(value_numeric) AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'context.compaction_events' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%' AND ('$scenario' = 'all' OR replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') = '$scenario') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time, 'approval_violations' AS metric, value_numeric AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'safety.approval_violations' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%'
SELECT ts AS time, 'canary_leaks' AS metric, value_numeric AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'safety.canary_leaks' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%'

SELECT ts AS time, 'credential_exposures' AS metric, value_numeric AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'safety.credential_exposures' AND model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%'

list.definition: SELECT 'all' AS scenario UNION SELECT DISTINCT replace(model_or_evaluator, 'long_conversation:', '') FROM analytics.scores WHERE model_or_evaluator LIKE 'long_conversation:%' ORDER BY 1
